=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:1-1425 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The template hook gained `--tests-file` support but the live .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py did not, so the two files have diverged (template lines 1548, 1568-1570, 1410-1529, 825-861).
  WHY: tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py::test_live_copies_match_their_templates fails on the head SHA (run 41345140411, job 124963249793), and CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA is empty on the push-event path (ci.yml lines 616, 626, 636, 657, 2067), so the pending-sync exemption does not apply and the required check stays red; both reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:825-873 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The template adds `--tests-file` support (`_selection_from_args`, `::name` exit 4/5 handling in `classify_baseline`), but the live copy .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py was not updated and is not in PR CHANGED FILES.
  WHY: test_live_copies_match_their_templates fails on head 702043090afd (run 41345140411, job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator), and push-event CI leaves CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA empty, so the check stays red until the live copy is synced or a reasoned entry is added to .github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json; source rated it MAJOR (same root cause as the live-copy finding above, kept separate because the cited file differs).
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:442-453, 643-657 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When both comment POSTs fail, `_recurred_marker_landed` cannot tell a failed comment-list read apart from an absent marker, so the heal is re-closed as completed (PATCH state=closed around lines 649-651) even if a POST actually stored the recurred marker.
  WHY: The next tick sees the stored pipeline-login marker posted after `mergedAt` and marks the heal `already_verified`, so a real recurrence stays closed with no escalation; severity disagreement: gemini, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR, sonnet rated it NIT; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputed it, saying a stored outcome=recurred marker increments prior_recurred (lines 314-315, 336) and feeds escalation (lines 659-668).
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:442-453 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_recurred_marker_landed` treats every non-zero exit as "marker not landed", including an empty `viewer` (returns 1 with no HTTP call) and jq parse errors.
  WHY: A malformed GraphQL response, or an API failure hidden by the jq fallback, cannot be told apart from an absent marker at the call site, so the heal is closed silently; source rated it NIT.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:442-453, 643-644 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_recurred_marker_landed` increments `TOTAL_READS` (line 447) but never checks or increments the per-heal `reads` counter against `MAX_READS_PER_HEAL=3` (line 79); the guards at lines 529 and 592 do not cover this call.
  WHY: A heal that already used 3 reads (runs list, compare, jobs) makes a 4th GET when both comment POSTs fail, which contradicts "at most 3 reads per heal" in changelog.d/heal-verify.md:11; all reviewers rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (or a reasoned entry in .github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Neither .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py nor .github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json is in PR CHANGED FILES or LAST RUN DIFF, the fragment defers the copy until after merge but push-event CI enforces parity strictly now, and the autofix comment dated 2026-11-01 acknowledges the deferral ("CI will stay red until it is synced"); z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputed gemini's claim that the PR description contains such deferral text.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (the live copy .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py was not updated):around lines 825-873 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The template adds `--tests-file` support (`_selection_from_args`, `::name` exit 4/5 handling in `classify_baseline`) but the live hook is not in PR CHANGED FILES, so test_live_copies_match_their_templates fails on head 702043090afd (run 41345140411, job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator).
  WHY: On push events `.github/workflows/ci.yml` lines 616/626/636/657/2067 set `CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA` from an empty `github.event.pull_request.base.sha`, so the pending-sync exemption never applies and the required check stays red until the live copy is synced or a reasoned entry for `hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py` is added to `.github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json` (pipeline editors cannot write `.claude/**`).
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:`_recurred_marker_landed` lines 442-453, called at lines 643-644; fallback re-close at lines 649-651 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed `gh api` gives `jq -e` no input, so a read failure looks the same as an absent marker, and the heal is re-closed as completed in both cases.
  WHY: If the POST was stored and the read also failed, the next tick skips the heal as `already_verified` and the recurrence stays closed without escalation; suggested fix: return a separate read-error status and take the existing `reclosed=false` path (leave the issue open, send the Telegram warning).
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:line 447 `TOTAL_READS=$((TOTAL_READS + 1))`; `MAX_READS_PER_HEAL` checks at lines 529 and 592 not consulted | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new lookup is an extra REST read that bypasses the per-heal budget, a 4th GET after the runs list, compare and jobs reads (lines 478/534/596).
  WHY: changelog.d/heal-verify.md still says "at most 3 reads per heal", so the code and its documented contract disagree.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Keep the live `.claude/` hook in sync with its template (agents.d/prepush-gate-tests-file.md: "the post-merge sync PR copies the template over it").
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, or a reasoned entry in .github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json
  Evidence of absence: Neither file is in PR CHANGED FILES; push-event CI enforces parity strictly now, so the deferral blocks a green head before merge.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.sh `pack_content` sed (around line 95, `-e 's/^===/= = =/'`): this sed only neutralises `===` at column 0, while `render_heal_evidence_pack` in scripts/clarify_github_facts.py also neutralises indented `===`. Fix: `-E -e 's/^([[:space:]]*)===/\1= = =/'` plus an indented `   === FAKE ===` line in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_evidence_bundle.py (2 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh lines 643-644: the lookup read bypasses the per-heal read guard. Fix: add `reads=$((reads + 1))` before the call, or change changelog.d/heal-verify.md to "at most 4 reads when a recurred comment fails to post" (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- NOTE (checked, no problem): the scripts/heal_reproduce.sh `::name` mapping is backed by `run_gate` emitting `"names": failing_names(...)` (workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py line 946), the worktree-HEAD fetch is bounded by the outer wall timeout, and the recurred marker string matches `render` (line 392).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:_recurred_marker_landed usage at lines 643-644 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The script re-closes the issue as `completed` if the fallback check (`_recurred_marker_landed`) fails, even if the comment was posted in the failed attempt.
  WHY: If the POST succeeded but the client received an error (e.g., connection reset), the script concludes the marker is missing and re-closes, the next cycle may skip the issue, and the fix-recurrence escalation path is not triggered.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:_recurred_marker_landed function call at lines 643-644 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function performs an API read but does not check or increment the per-heal `reads` counter against `MAX_READS_PER_HEAL=3`.
  WHY: A heal could exceed its documented budget of 3 GitHub API reads if the earlier steps (list runs, compare, jobs) already used the full budget.
